name: io.github.genesis-plan/lingnao
title: LingNao
description: LingNao — a deterministic reasoning SERVICE for ANY AI agent or robot. One MCP gateway `lingnao` (op + args → structured verdict) gives any agent deterministic, hallucination-free, reproducible reasoning: deliberate planning (A*/RSG + deterministic MCTS), causal inference (do-calculus, Pearl's ladder), PAC uncertainty bounds, and mathematical soundness stress-tests (Baire category / compactness / algebraic variety / van der Waerden / Cauchy-Lipschitz — each backed by a real theorem). No neural network in the loop, fully reproducible, fail-closed. Method & theorem basis: docs/00. Zero dependencies.
